title: Lucie - Expedition 33 Character Guide | Ex-Expeditioner
description: Complete guide to Lucie in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. A former expeditioner who chose to stay in Lumière, with connections to Gustave and Seba.

sections.title: Lucie — Character Overview
sections.content:
Lucie, ex-expeditioner

Lucie is an NPC in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. She initially trained as an expeditioner with the intention of joining Expedition 33, but ultimately decided to remain in Lumière for her final year. Her spot on the expedition was filled by Seba.

sections.title: Story & Background
sections.content:
Lucie trained alongside the members of Expedition 33 and was expected to join them. However, she made the difficult decision to stay in Lumière rather than venture into the dangerous expedition. Her spot was taken by Seba.

Key Facts

  • Trained as an expeditioner — has combat knowledge and expedition experience
  • Chose to remain in Lumière for her "final year" — implying she accepted the Gommage rather than fight
  • Has an interesting conversation with Gustave that reveals her reasons for staying
  • Her decision represents the counterpoint to the expedition — choosing to accept fate rather than fight it

Conversation with Gustave

Lucie has a notable dialogue exchange with Gustave that explores why she decided to stay. This conversation adds depth to Gustave's character and his motivation to fight against the Paintress.

sections.title: Thematic Significance
sections.content:
Lucie serves as an important thematic contrast in the story:

  • Acceptance vs. Resistance — While the expedition fights against fate, Lucie chose to accept it
  • The cost of fighting — Her decision highlights that choosing to fight isn't the only valid choice
  • Gustave's drive — Her conversation with Gustave reinforces why he chose to go
  • Seba's position — Her leaving created the opening for Seba, affecting the party composition

sections.title: Where to Find Lucie
sections.content:
Lucie is found in Lumière. She can be spoken to at various points:

  • Before the expedition departs
  • During returns to Lumière (if applicable)
  • Her dialogue may change based on story progression
